limits: Direct actual native producer/window/render/highlight API contracts with prepared names and party counts1..4. These are bounded unit/integration controls, not extra naturally reached story parents.

Generic exclusions intentionally contain a synthetic high byte; existing ASCII fallback is an independently expected space. The real ordinary parent suite covers legal source names, actual D-pad input and selected save16 cold continuations.
Title and structure controls are compared to the red baseline separately; no tiny-title/file-slot redesign or new save fields.
